title: After the Osaka Hai: Hands to the Sky

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Being selfish just causes trouble for everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I had to prove that the sacrifices they made in sending me off were worth it. I couldn't afford to waste a single second.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Because I love my family.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I was afraid my sisters would think I was getting special treatment. I didn't want to see the family I worked so hard to support fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I convinced myself I had to become this reliable older sister. I had to protect our cozy home in any way I could.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (But the truth is I'm not the big hero I thought I could be. I'm still just plain old me…)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (And my family loves me just the way I am… They're happy to bless me with all their support.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I… am Ines Fujin, and right now, I can just keep on enjoying racing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… These cheers are so loud!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This feels incredible!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (If running with 100% of my strength is what I do…)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I want to spread my arms wide and welcome everyone's feelings with 100% of my energy too.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer! And I want to discuss our next goal!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I was thinking we could do the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen is a 2,200-meter G1 held in June. It's a grand prix, meaning the most popular runners get to take the turf.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You need a lot of fans to run in a grand prix, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So that got me thinking—maybe running in the Takarazuka Kinen means you're, like, carrying the weight of people's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I know that compared to others, there might not be as many people who see their dreams in me, but still…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to stand on that great big stage and live up to those dreams anyway. I want to show that I can bear that burden.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Caught up in her sheer determination, I find myself imagining who else might be running in this year's Takarazuka Kinen.
choice_data_list: That means you'll have to beat Mejiro Ryan and Mejiro McQueen.
That means you'll have to beat Mejiro Ryan and Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ryan and McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: How do you know they'll be there? The spring G1 races have only just started, right?
choice_data_list: Because I know everyone's expecting great things from them both.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan and Mejiro McQueen have both been the subject of an enormous amount of attention lately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure if "perfect" is the word, but the way McQueen stalks the pace before overpowering the competition is really something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then there's Ryan, who's gained popularity by displaying a level of determination worthy of her family name, remaining resilient no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They've both become pillars of the current racing scene.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So they're going to be entering for sure. If this is going to be the race of people's dreams, those two have got to be there.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha… Now I get it! I really am hopeless, aren't I?!
choice_data_list: People are expecting great things from you too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Oh—I mean, thanks for the vote of confidence, but… I wasn't really talking about my chances in the race.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's just that… I've been so focused on myself recently, I feel like I've been living under a rock.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's like the only thing I've been thinking about is me, you know? I really think I should broaden my perspective.
choice_data_list: But there's nothing wrong with being totally focused on one thing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? You always have to back me up like that, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's my job as her trainer to support her, after all. And besides…
choice_data_list: I want you to be totally absorbed in running, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? But I'm pretty sure I'm already too absorbed in it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Watching Ines Fujin scratch her cheek sheepishly, I'm reminded of the conversations I've had with others about her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We all feel exactly the same way.
choice_data_list: (We all want her to enjoy racing to the absolute fullest.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why, as her trainer, I'll continue to do my best to support her! And now it's time to focus on our next goal—the Takarazuka Kinen!
